profile: Base AGTP-08 Level 2 signed identity-document path, Governance Tokens, EXECUTE composition, Attribution-Records, and optional RATS evidence; AGTP-CERT and companion-draft semantics are not imported

results.diagnostic: The declared Agent-ID resolves to a valid signed document, but resolving a public document does not prove that the live sender controls an agent key.
results.permitted_conclusion: The declared Agent-ID has a valid trusted document; base Level 2 verification does not prove that the live sender controls the named agent.
prohibited_conclusions: The live presenter is authenticated as agtp:sha256:agent-a.
Resolving a valid public document is proof of possession by the requester.
results.title: Wrong Presenter

results.diagnostic: Distinct signatures and a checkable execution environment do not establish that the verifier is outside the executor's organizational control.
results.permitted_conclusion: The signed record and evidence are checkable, but base AGTP-08 does not establish that their verifier is organizationally independent.
prohibited_conclusions: Different signing keys prove independent control.
RATS evidence makes the party appraising it organizationally independent.
results.title: Same-Control Verifier

results.diagnostic: The attribution record is intact, but its optional evidence cannot be established as current or appraised; signature success does not repair that missing result.
results.permitted_conclusion: The Attribution-Record and result hash are intact, but the referenced execution evidence could not be established as current or appraised.
prohibited_conclusions: Unverifiable evidence was rejected on its merits.
A valid Attribution-Record signature proves the referenced evidence was successfully appraised.
A fresh Governance Token makes completion evidence fresh.
results.title: Stale/Unverifiable Completion

results.diagnostic: The identity, scope, token signature, expiry, agent identifier, and high-level action all pass while the reused Border digest detects a substituted payload.
results.permitted_conclusion: Identity, scope, token freshness, agent ID, and the high-level action label pass, but base AGTP-08 does not establish that the observed MCP arguments are the exact A2A-authorized payload.
prohibited_conclusions: A fresh Governance Token proves every byte of the carried MCP payload was authorized.
A matching action label and Task-ID make different arguments the same action.
results.title: A2A to MCP Action Swap
